description.narrative:
Media and Information Literacy (MIL) is a critical 21st-century skill that empowers individuals to access, critically evaluate, and effectively utilize media and information. In a world characterized by an abundance of information sources, fostering MIL is vital for informed decision-making, active citizenship, and a thriving democracy. This project concept note outlines a comprehensive proposal for advancing MIL in Lebanon, focusing on education and media, with a strong commitment to promoting gender equality. It aims to promote MIL among students and teachers, integrate it into curricula, and consistently promote gender equality throughout all activities.
This project places emphasis on the inter-sectorality between education and media as two fundamental sectors of UNESCO. By bridging these two sectors, the project aims to provide students and teachers with essential MIL skills and integrate MIL into learning in alignment with UNESCO's 'Transforming Education' initiative.
